present.label: Read the input
present.story: {n} planks in a row. Any two can be the walls of the barrel.
present.formal: heights has {n} values. Maximise min(h[i], h[j]) × (j − i).

initialize.label: Widest barrel first
initialize.story: One builder takes the first plank (position {left}), the other the last (position {right}).

measure:record.label: Measure
measure:record.story: Walls of {leftHeight} and {rightHeight}: water rises to {height} over a width of {width}, holding {area}. A new record.

measure:keep.label: Measure
measure:keep.story: Walls of {leftHeight} and {rightHeight}: water rises to {height} over a width of {width}, holding {area}. The record stays {best}.

move-left.label: Drop the left wall
move-left.story: The left plank ({height}) is shorter than the right ({other}). Any narrower barrel with it holds less, so drop it: move to position {to}.

move-right.label: Drop the right wall
move-right.story: The right plank ({height}) is not taller than the left ({other}). Any narrower barrel with it holds less, so drop it: move to position {to}.

done.label: Return the best
done.story: The builders have met. The biggest barrel used planks {left} and {right} and holds {best}.
